description: Na₃PO₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅42₁c space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-69°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.30 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids and corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.25 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.52 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.83 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 77°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅P octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 8°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one P atom.
